manifest.name: meow-memory
manifest.description: Cross-session project memory for DeepSeek Harness: seven-layer SQLite memory, first-turn snapshot injection, per-message keyword hits, memory_remember/search/project tools, automatic reflection with reflection-fold UI, and idle-triggered dream consolidation (peak-hour suppressed).

scripts.test: node tests/build-host-peers.mjs && npm run build && node scripts/check-lang.mjs && node test.mjs && node tests/config-volatile.mjs && node tests/trust.mjs && node tests/client-fold.mjs && node tests/client-multiview.mjs && node tests/cli...

bundle.text:
# meow-memory bundle patch: inserts this plugin into a profile's layer stack.
# Applied when a profile lists this bundle (or copied by hand for manual
# installs). Rows reference the package by name so Node resolution finds the
# installed code.
- insert:
    - id: meow-memory
      name: 'meow-memory'

readme.text:
| [中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md) | [Português (BR)](README.pt-br.md) | [MIT License](LICENSE) |
| :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）打造的跨会话记忆插件。

当前版本 **0.31.0** ｜ 版本变更见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) ｜ 兼容 **dsh 0.1.5**

- **七层记忆**：`soul`（AI 自身）/ `user`（用户信息与偏好）/ `project`（项目信息，含 `subcategory`）/ `fact`（原子事实）/ `lesson`（教训与纠正）/ `topic`（进行中的话题，带目标句）/ `rules`（设计原则与行为准则）。每层一张 SQLite 表，UUID 带时间前缀，id 顺序即创建顺序。
- **首轮注入（长期记忆块）**：第一条用户消息前注入 soul / user / 设计原则 / 记忆导引。记忆作为独立 plugin snapshot 消息放在真实 user 消息之前，**不改写用户 prompt**；**首轮不跑关键词命中**（命中从第二轮起）。
- **每消息关键词命中**：从第二条用户消息起，每条真实用户消息检索 fact/lesson/rules/topic（全局 + 当前 project 锚定），top-2 命中注入。命中基于**条目关键词**而非全文。
- **当前 project 锚定**：带 project 参数即锚定该会话的当前项目；未锚定时命中只搜全局（用户闲聊不误伤）。
- **缓存友好设计**：静态 `meow-memory:guide` section 在 system prompt 中注册一次——文本恒定，破坏不了 provider 的 KV 缓存。
- **压缩后重注入**：会话压缩后，下一轮自动重新注入长期记忆快照 + 本会话查阅过的项目全景 + 本会话写入过的记忆原文，AI 不会因为压缩突然失忆。
- **七层之上的三件事**：写入自动去重合并、按 `updated_at` 展示记忆时间戳、全局信息用全局标记（区别于留空）。
- **按窗口 dream**：窗口空闲 ≥3 小时即允许整理，由该窗口自己的主 agent 分三轮处理（原子记忆 / topic / 项目总结），**峰时抑制**（默认北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，API 峰谷电价峰时）不触发。也可敲 `/dream` 立刻手动整理。
- **反思**：单次任务内连续 ≥7 个工具 step 后，插件询问模型自上次整理以来是否有值得记忆的内容。最后工具是 `memory_*` 视为已主动记忆、不重复反思。
- **外部记忆库信任门**：工作区自带的 `.dsh-meow` 若非本机创建（如 clone 的外部仓库），默认暂停注入/检索/整理——首轮提示一次，`/meow-trust` 一键信任、即刻生效；本机创建与升级前打开过的工作区自动信任，正常使用零感知。
- **客户端 UI**：注入文本折叠成横条、反思/dream 轮折叠成一条可展开的卡片、会话列表显示 dream 状态图标（🌙 已整理 / 呼吸灯 进行中 / 灰月牙斜杠 已跳过）。
- **无需

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory
```

一条命令装完即生效：安装时自动编译（包内含 `prepare` 脚本），自动挂载，重启 `dsh web` 后新会话自动加载插件。

> pnpm ≥10 默认会阻止安装期的构建脚本：首次 `add` 可能失败并提示 `allowBuilds`，按提示把输出的键加进 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 后重跑即可。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove meow-memory
```

想要巴西葡语打包版本的仓库：[coutogilson](https://github.com/coutogilson) 的 fork：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:coutogilson/dsh-meow-memory
```

readme.section: 手动安装（开发者，任意 DSH 安装，无需 npm）
readme.text:
1. 把本包复制（或软链）到 profile 的 `node_modules`：

```sh
   mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules
   ln -s /path/to/meow-memory ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/meow-memory
   ```

（Windows：`New-Item -ItemType Junction ...` —— NTFS junction，无需管理员权限。）

2. 把 `meow-memory` 加进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

3. 重启 `dsh web`。新会话自动加载插件。

支持 **dsh 0.1.5**（含最新的 `0.1.5-rc.1`），同时向下兼容旧版本——升级 dsh 不需要改本插件，也不需要改任何配置。

插件不写死版本号，而是运行时探测宿主能力，因此新旧版走各自正确的分支。已实测两代：`0.1.5-rc.1` 上首次注入、记忆工具调用、客户端渲染全部正常；`0.1.1-rc.2` 上行为与历史版本完全一致。

所有字段均可选（profile patch 或 `cordis.patch.yml`）。**也可以不手编文件**：DSH 设置页里有本插件的「喵记忆」标签页（与「通用」「模型」平级），下面这些项全部图形化可改、字段级保存、可单项恢复默认（恢复默认 = 回到插件出厂默认，不受 patch 基线影响）；保存后热重载/重启 meow-memory 插件生效。

```yaml
- id: meow-memory
  name: 'meow-memory'
  config:
    enabled: true          # 总开关

**完整字段、类型与默认值见 [docs/配置参考.md](docs/配置参考.md)**，含 `titleMax` / `autoMigrate` / `homeDir` / `disabledWorkspaces` / `backup` / `delegate` 等全部配置项。

> ⚠️ **`promptLang` 首次使用建议显式配置。** 它决定注入/反思/dream 文案与工具描述的语言，同时影响模型写记忆条目用的语言——关键词按条目语言提取。内置 `zh` / `en` / `pt-br` 三套语言包。配置值就是 `src/prompts/` 的子目录名，**逐字匹配**：填一个不存在的名字（例如 `pt`）不会报错，而是静默落回中文包。详见 [docs/配置参考.md](docs/配置参考.md)。
插件界面文案跟随 DSH 的「设置 → 通用 → 语言」（内置中文 / English / Português (Brasil)），与 `promptLang` 是两层、互不影响。详见 [docs/配置参考.md](docs/配置参考.md)。

```
第一条用户消息（首轮）         第二条起的每条消息                空闲≥3h 且非峰时
┌────────────────────┐        ┌────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────┐
│ ===== 长期记忆 ===== │        │ 可能相关的记忆，仅供  │        │ 按窗口 dream：        │
│ 【关于你】(soul)     │        │ 参考：keywords 命中   │        │ 三轮（含项目总结）      │

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `memory_remember` | 写入一条记忆（必填 content/project/keywords/importance，自动去重合并） |
| `memory_search` | 关键词检索（BM25 × 近期权重，支持 level/project/status/days 过滤） |
| `memory_project` | 取回某项目的完整注入段落（**project 参数必填**） |
| `memory_find_similar` | 查重与冲突检测 |
| `memory_read` | 按 id 读取单条完整元数据 |
| `memory_update` | 修正 status / importance / goal / keywords |
| `memory_dream` | 手动触发本窗口的记忆整理 |
| `memory_home` | 查看 / 切换全局数据目录 |

另有 `/dream` 命令：在输入框敲 `/dream` 立即手动唤起本窗口的记忆整理，不受峰时抑制。
**参数、返回与副作用见 [docs/工具参考.md](docs/工具参考.md)**（含 `memory_project` 的项目锚定副作用与 `memory_home` 的三个预设目录标记）。

```sh
npm install
npm run build          # esbuild 打包 → lib/index.js（宿主 peer 保持 external）
npm run test           # 228 项逻辑测试：db / bm25 / migrate / inject / reflect / dream / tools / apply
```

`@deepseek-ai/*` 包位于 dsh-meow pnpm workspace 中，不在本包的 `node_modules` 里。
在 Windows 上，`npm run link-workspace`（或 `scripts/link-workspace.ps1`）创建 workspace
包的 junction 镜像，使 esbuild 能解析它们；`build.mjs` 通过 `nodePaths` 引用。
构建不需要安装可选的 `dsh-llm` peer。直接用 Node 运行测试时，仍需从匹配的 DSH
workspace 链接 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`；正常插件运行由 DSH 的 profile loader
解析宿主提供的 peer。不要把它加回 devDependencies，否则 `file:` / `link:`
安装可能再次向 profile 引入宿主核心包的另一份副本（#84）。

`node tests/build-host-peers.mjs` 单独验证无宿主 peer 的干净构建（#87）。
`node tests/host-peers.mjs /path/to/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh` 使用另行安装的
官方 DSH，验证隔离 profile 的真实 Host 装载和消息契约，不调用模型。

Cross-session memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

Version **0.31.0** ｜ Changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) ｜ Supports **dsh 0.1.5**

- **Seven memory layers**: `soul` (the AI itself) / `user` (user basics & preferences) / `project` (per-project info with `subcategory`) / `fact` (atomic facts) / `lesson` (mistakes & corrections) / `topic` (ongoing discussion arcs with a goal sentence) / `rules` (design principles & behavioral rules). One SQLite table per layer, UUIDs are time-prefixed so id order == creation order.
- **First-turn injection (long-term memory block)**: before the first user message, soul / user / design principles / memory guide are injected. The memory is inserted as an independent plugin snapshot directly before the real user message; **the user's prompt is never rewritten**, and **no keyword hits run on the first turn** (hits start from the second message).
- **Per-message keyword hits**: from the second user message on, every real user message is matched against fact/lesson/rules/topic (scope = global + current-project anchor) and the top-2 hits are injected. Matching is based on **entry keywords**, not full text.
- **Current-project anchor**: any `memory_remember/search/update/project` call with a `project` parameter anchors the session's current project; unanchored sessions only hit global en

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory
```

One command and it works: the package compiles itself on install (it ships a `prepare` script), mounts automatically, and new sessions load the plugin after you restart `dsh web`.

> pnpm ≥10 blocks install-time build scripts by default: the first `add` may fail and mention `allowBuilds`. Add the keys it prints to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and run it again.
```sh

cd $DSH_HOME/profiles/web          # default home: ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npm install meow-memory

```

dsh plugin --profile web add github:coutogilson/dsh-meow-memory

readme.section: By hand (any DSH install, no npm needed)
readme.text:
1. Copy (or symlink) this package into the profile's `node_modules`:

```sh
   mkdir -p ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules
   ln -s /path/to/meow-memory ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/meow-memory
   ```

(On Windows: `New-Item -ItemType Junction ...` — NTFS junction, no admin needed.)

2. Add `meow-memory` to the profile `package.json`'s `dsh.profile.bundles` (same as above).

3. Restart `dsh web`. New sessions pick up the plugin automatically.

Supports **dsh 0.1.5** (including the latest `0.1.5-rc.1`) and stays backward compatible with older releases — upgrading dsh needs no change to this plugin or its configuration.

The plugin never hardcodes a version: it probes host capabilities at runtime, so new and old releases each take their correct branch. Both generations are verified — on `0.1.5-rc.1` first-turn injection, memory tool calls, and client rendering all work; on `0.1.1-rc.2` behavior is unchanged from previous releases.

All fields are optional (profile patch or `cordis.patch.yml`). **You don't have to hand-edit files**: the DSH settings page has a dedicated "喵记忆" tab for this plugin (peer of General/Models/Plugins) where every option below is editable in place, saved per-field with one-click restore-to-default (restoring means the plugin's built-in factory default, not the patch baseline); reload/restart the meow-memory plugin after saving for changes to take effect.

```yaml
- id: meow-memory
  name: 'meow-memory'
  config:
    enabled: true          # master switch

**Every field, its type and its default are in [docs/configuration-reference.md](docs/configuration-reference.md)**, including `titleMax` / `autoMigrate` / `homeDir` / `disabledWorkspaces` / `backup` / `delegate`.

> ⚠️ **Set `promptLang` explicitly on first use.** It decides the language of injected/reflection/dream prompts and of tool descriptions, and it also shapes the language the model writes memory entries in — keywords are extracted in the entry's language. `zh` / `en` / `pt-br` ship built in. The value *is* the subdirectory name under `src/prompts/` and is matched **verbatim**: a name that does not exist (e.g. `pt`) raises nothing and silently falls back to the Chinese pack. See [docs/configuration-reference.md](docs/configuration-reference.md).

The plugin's UI copy follows DSH's Settings → General → Language (built in: 中文 / English / Português (Brasil)) and is a separate layer from `promptLang`; the two do not interfere. See [docs/configuration-reference.md](docs/configuration-reference.md).

```
First user message (turn 1)      Every message from turn 2            idle ≥3h, not peak
┌────────────────────┐          ┌────────────────────┐        ┌──────────────────────┐
│ ===== 长期记忆 ===== │          │ 可能相关的记忆，仅供  │        │ per-window dream:     │
│ 【关于你】(soul)     │          │ 参考：keyword hits    │        │ three rounds (atomic/ │

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `memory_remember` | Write one memory (content/project/keywords/importance required; dedups and merges) |
| `memory_search` | Keyword search (BM25 × recency; level/project/status/days filters) |
| `memory_project` | Fetch a project's whole-project injection paragraph (**`project` parameter required**) |
| `memory_find_similar` | Duplicate & conflict detection |
| `memory_read` | Read one entry's complete metadata by id |
| `memory_update` | Correct status / importance / goal / keywords |
| `memory_dream` | Manually trigger this window's consolidation |
| `memory_home` | Inspect / switch the global data directory |

There is also the `/dream` command: type `/dream` in the composer to consolidate this window right away, immune to peak-hour suppression.

**Parameters, returns and side effects are in [docs/tool-reference.md](docs/tool-reference.md)** (including `memory_project`'s anchoring side effect and `memory_home`'s three preset directory markers).

```sh
npm install
npm run build          # esbuild bundle → lib/index.js (Host peers stay external)
npm run test           # 228 logic tests: db / bm25 / migrate / inject / reflect / dream / tools / apply
```

The `@deepseek-ai/*` packages live in the dsh-meow pnpm workspace, not in this package's
`node_modules`. On Windows, `npm run link-workspace` (or `scripts/link-workspace.ps1`)
creates junction mirrors of the workspace packages so esbuild can resolve them;
`build.mjs` uses `nodePaths` to pick them up. Building does not require the optional
`dsh-llm` peer. To run tests directly with Node, link `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` from a
matching DSH workspace; normal plugin loading resolves it through the DSH profile
loader. Do not restore it as a devDependency: `file:` / `link:` installs can introduce
a second copy of a Host core package into the profile (#84).

`node tests/build-host-peers.mjs` checks a clean build without Host peers (#87).
`node tests/host-peers.mjs /path/to/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh` uses an independently
installed official DSH to check real Host loading and message contracts in an isolated
profile, without model calls.
